title: Decisions
description:
Write in `solution.c` (`#include <stdbool.h>` for `bool`):

```c
const char *grade(int score);           /* 90+ "A", 80+ "B", 70+ "C", 60+ "D", below "F" */
bool is_leap(int year);                 /* divisible by 4, except centuries, except every 400 years */
int days_in_month(int month, int year); /* month 1 to 12; 0 for a month that does not exist. Use a switch */
const char *kind_of(char c);            /* "letter", "digit", "space" (' ', '\t' or '\n') or "other" */
```

`const char *` is the type of a string literal such as `"A"`: returning one from a function is fine.
hints: For `grade`, test from the top: `if (score >= 90) return "A";` and so on; each `return` ends the function.
A leap year is divisible by 4 and not by 100, or divisible by 400: `(year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || year % 400 == 0`.
In `days_in_month`, stack the 31-day months as `case 1: case 3: ...` and handle February with `is_leap`.
